definition_en: The ability to work with artificial intelligence tools, machine learning concepts, and large-scale data analytics to derive insights and automate processes.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk bekerja dengan alatan kecerdasan buatan, konsep pembelajaran mesin dan analitik data berskala besar bagi memperoleh cerapan serta mengautomasikan proses.
typical_tasks_en:
• Use a machine learning model to predict next month's demand for childcare slots.
• Analyse customer behaviour data from the loyalty app to identify churn signals.
• Fine-tune a chatbot's responses using conversation logs.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Gunakan model pembelajaran mesin untuk meramal permintaan slot taska bulan depan.
• Analisis data tingkah laku pelanggan daripada aplikasi kesetiaan untuk mengenal pasti isyarat churn.
• Perhalusi respons chatbot menggunakan log perbualan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires using AI tools or machine learning models
• The task involves analysing large datasets using advanced analytics
• The task requires understanding AI capabilities and limitations
• The task involves training, tuning, or deploying AI systems
• The task requires deriving insights from complex or unstructured data
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only basic data entry or simple spreadsheet work
• The user uses standard software without any AI or analytics component
• The task requires no understanding of data science or AI concepts
• The user performs routine reporting without advanced analysis
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task involves basic data handling or routine reporting with no AI, model, or advanced analytics component.

confusions.boundary_rule: AI focuses on data-driven models. Programming is general code writing.
confusions.example_task: Train a model to predict customer churn.

confusions.boundary_rule: AI uses algorithms on large data. Analytical thinking is human reasoning with evidence.
confusions.example_task: Use a machine learning model to segment customers and then interpret the segments.
confusions.expected_labels: AI and big data; Analytical thinking

confusions.boundary_rule: AI is advanced analytics. Technological literacy is general tool usage.
confusions.example_task: Build a predictive dashboard using AI features in the CRM.
confusions.expected_labels: AI and big data; Technological literacy

examples.task_text: Use a machine learning model to predict next month's demand for childcare slots.
Use a machine-learning churn model on large-scale loyalty-app behaviour data to identify customers at risk of leaving.
examples.reason: Explicitly applies a machine-learning model to large-scale behavioural data.

examples.task_text: Export the monthly report from the CRM.
examples.reason: Basic data retrieval, not AI or advanced analytics.
